citation.authors: Muizzuddin N, Hellemans L, Van Overloop L, Corstjens H et al

record.population: African American, Caucasian and East Asian volunteers
record.design: Objective stratum corneum measurements (water loss, tape-stripped ceramides, protein cohesion)
record.finding: African American skin showed low ceramide levels and high protein cohesion in the upper layers. The authors interpret this as consistent with the high prevalence of xerosis in black skin.
record.note: Funding and author affiliations not checked. Laboratory measurement of skin layers.
